description.fallback: The Joestar group begins to cross the Red Sea, the final stretch before Egypt. Jotaro says that they're heading in the wrong direction, and that the boat is going towards a small island. Joseph says that they need to meet someone there who is very important to their journey, but does not reveal who it is.
